context: Evaluates correct usage of the collection management actions in the useScene store from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must use createCollection, deleteCollection, updateCollection, addToCollection, and removeFromCollection to manage named node groups, and work with CollectionId and Collection types.

checklist.name: createCollection usage
checklist.description: Calls useScene.getState().createCollection(name, nodeIds?) and uses the returned CollectionId, verifying the collection appears in useScene.getState().collections.

checklist.name: addToCollection / removeFromCollection
checklist.description: Calls addToCollection(collectionId, nodeId) and removeFromCollection(collectionId, nodeId) to mutate collection membership, checking nodeIds in the collection object updates accordingly.

checklist.name: updateCollection usage
checklist.description: Calls updateCollection(collectionId, { name: newName }) or similar partial update, verifying only the specified fields change.

checklist.name: deleteCollection usage
checklist.description: Calls deleteCollection(collectionId) and verifies the collection is removed from useScene.getState().collections.
